cohort: The study included 27 infants born to 21 mothers who had organ transplants and were receiving immunosuppressive treatment.
finding: Apart from an increased risk of prematurity, low birth weight, and cesarean delivery, infants exposed to maternal organ transplantation and immunosuppressive treatment showed no other adverse effects in the early neonatal period, though specific laboratory abnormalities (lymphopenia, neutropenia, thrombocytopenia, hyperkalemia, creatinine elevation) were detected but returned to normal within a few days.
mod_finding: All infants in the study cohort were delivered via cesarean section, indicating an increased risk of cesarean delivery associated with maternal organ transplantation and immunosuppressive treatment.
birth_weight: 67% of the included infants had low birth weight.
gest_age: 74% of the included infants were born premature.
